methods.what: Multiplicity sums for intersections of two curves, total equal to product of degrees (Bézout-type count)
Differential relation along intersection of F=0 and G=0 expressing dx, dy via partial derivatives (Jacobian)
Splitting a double integral 1/(FG) into boundary integrals over F=0 and G=0
Count of branch points versus genus (Riemann–Hurwitz type relation)
Sum of integrals over intersection points evaluated as w/2 − α
Total derivative of G along F=0 (implicit differentiation)
